text:
Maria Gonzalez: @here publishing SDK v4.0 (JS/TS + CLI) tomorrow 08:00 PT. Docs are reindexed and reorganized. Important breaking items below — please skim the migration guide: https://intranet.redwood.local/docs/guides/sdk-4-js-migration :rocket:
Liam Patel: Quick Q — is this only JS or are we changing the API shape across all SDKs?
Maria Gonzalez: It's primarily auth + a few surface changes across all SDKs. JS/TS gets the CLI and package rename (redwood-sdk -> @redwood/inference) and a new streaming callback signature. Python gets auth param rename and a couple method aliases.
Emily Chen: What's changing for the CLI? Any command names removed?
Maria Gonzalez: CLI: token arg now --token (was --api-key), new login flow uses browser+device code. Old flags still accepted for 30 days with warnings. Also CLI config moved from ~/.redwoodrc to ~/.config/redwood/rc.json. Docs updated with migration steps and sample scripts.
Olga: CS needs timeline for communicating to customers. Also want to know if search indexing will break any existing permalinks in KB.
Maria Gonzalez: Timeline: rollout starts 2026-06-03, hosted will emit deprecation warnings starting 2026-06-10, legacy headers fully removed for hosted on 2026-08-01. Dedicated/Private: grace period until 2026-10-01. We add compatibility aliases for 4.0 -> they are removed in 4.1. Permalinks: we preserved top-level doc slugs but search tokens changed — we reindexed search and added redirect rules for renamed pages. KB permalinks should be stable.
Docs-bot: Published: /docs/guides/sdk-4-js-migration, /docs/reference/js, /docs/cli/migration. Search reindex job: job-id 20260602-423.
DevRel-bot: Scheduled town hall: SDK v4 launch Q&A 2026-06-04 10:00 PT (link in the calendar). Please RSVP.
Kevin: Any runtime work needed for streaming changes? Eng-runtime should be aware if the streaming callback changes shape.
Liam Patel: Engineers: streaming callbacks now receive an event object with type field ("token", "done", "error") instead of raw chunks. This helps structured events for function-calling and tool outputs. Backwards compat: old style callbacks are wrapped but will log a deprecation message.
Jordan: Can Console expose which customers still hit streaming endpoints in the old format? CS wants a list for outreach.
Maria Gonzalez: Yes — Console -> Admin -> API Usage -> Streaming Format has a boolean breakdown. We'll provide a weekly CSV export to CS with customer id, last-seen timestamp, and SDK detection (user-agent).
Olga: We'll run a targeted outreach for any customer with >1000 streaming calls/week using legacy format two weeks after rollout.
Maria Gonzalez: Action items:
- eng-apis / eng-runtime: review streaming wrapper PR (link posted in #eng-apis) and confirm rollback test.
- docs: review CLI migration pages and add screenshots for new login flow + config paths.
- devrel: prepare town hall slides and example migration repo.
- cs: import weekly export into Gainsight (template in /docs/internal/cs/outreach-templates).
Maria Gonzalez: Extra notes: we added a "How to detect SDK version" header to JS reference (user-agent sniff + bundle detection snippet). Also added a small node script to bulk-migrate CI credentials to the new token format (repo: internal/ci-migrate).
Emily Chen: Thanks — please post the rollout checklist and rollback steps in this thread when available.
Maria Gonzalez: Will do. Posting final checklist and rollback plan in #release-war-room an hour before rollout. Ping me directly for urgent issues. :wave:
